review_notes.evidence: KU271 BS AX exact.png and KU271 center rails r60-73 sliced.png
review_notes.finding: The vertical from BS.D10 rises on c131 but the scan shows a full wire gap before the separate AQ-to-AX.D09 rail resumes. The two same-column portions are not joined.

review_notes.source_review: All 43 native card portions, 79 input terminals, signal margins, center rails, cable table and footer were checked against native whole-page and enlarged crops. The densely packed rails were spaced to keep every vertical beside its printed pin label. Foreign pin-stub crossings have no source diamond and remain unjoined.
